source: DHM Islamic Studies Level 1 (ISLB A1) · lesson 1. Exercises reused from the lesson.
topic: Al-Ahad: Allah is One, unique, and needs nothing

learn.en: Allah is Al-Ahad, The One. He is completely unique, alone, and has no partners.
learn.title: Allah is One

learn.en: Allah has always existed. He was not born, He has no parents, and He will never die.
learn.title: Always there

learn.en: Allah has no wife and no children. He is perfect and does not need anyone to help Him.
learn.title: No family

learn.en: We need to eat, drink and sleep. Allah needs none of these — He is the One who gives us our food and drink.
learn.title: No needs

learn.en: Allah never gets tired and never sleeps. He is always watching over you, so you can talk to Him at any time.
learn.title: Never tired

learn.en: The heart of our faith: There is no god but Allah.
learn.title: Our faith in one sentence

opts: He had a beginning long ago
He has no beginning and no end

quiz.en: True or false? Allah needs to eat and drink to stay strong.
True or false? Allah was not born and He has no father or mother.
True or false? Everything in the world has an end, but Allah will not die.

think.q: Every person you know has a birthday. Does Allah have a birthday? Why is He unique?
think.a: No! Allah was never born and has no beginning. Being unique means He is not like anything He created.

parents.summary: Allah is One (Al-Aḥad): no parents, no children, no partners; He never sleeps, gets tired or needs food.

try.en: There is no god but Allah

parents.tip: Ask him: Does Allah ever get tired? Can we talk to Him at night? Let him explain why.
